rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following for FAA review:

  • 9. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with their treating physician no more than 90 days before the AME exam.

It should include a summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); clinical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment and plan (prognosis); and follow-up.

  • 10. Copies of any testing already performed (e.g. X-ray, MRI, CT, or MRA).
  • 11. If surgery has been performed, submit:
    • a. Admission History & Physical (H&P)
    • b. Hospital Discharge Summary
    • c. Operative report(s).
